hooks.name: API contract sync
hooks.description: When the zod schemas change, bring docs/api-contract.md and lib/mocks/*.json back in line, run the contract tests, and summarize changes for the frontend developer.

action.prompt: Check that docs/api-contract.md and every JSON file in lib/mocks/ still match the zod schemas, run `npm test -- tests/contract`, fix mismatches, and list what changed so I can tell the frontend developer.
